lots.working: Keep: lowest photo-matched SOLD $40 / 1.198 = $33.39, round down $30 (all-in $35.94). lots.confidence_reason: Lot number chalked on the slab read and matches Gowans' title; 6 photo-matched SOLD lots opened via API. Not High because species is taken on Gowans' word and length, width and thickness are estimates from one photo.

(c) 'LARGE HUON PINE LENGTH' $160 (19 Oct 2025, 0 bids) and HUON PINE LOG $70 to $140: confirmed in the API but different items (length/log), not used. (d) 2 SLABS OF HUON PINE aggregates: multi-slab lots, not the same item. Corrections: the $180 top single was April 2026 not Dec 2025 ($170 was Dec 2025); the 4 Oct $155 lot had 6 bids not 7.
lots.key_photo_findings: Chalk '1124 23/10/26' plus round 1124 sticker. Long slab, wany edge on both sides (bark mostly gone on left, thin bark on right), a long surface check or split running down from the top end, small knot near the lower left. Even, plain straight grain with some faint figure low down; bandsaw marks visible so it is rough sawn, probably not kiln dried.
lots.condition: Rough sawn, likely green or air dried; end check/split at the top end; plain grade.
lots.question_for_gowans: Length, width and thickness of lot 1124, how far the top split runs, and whether it is air dried. Is the species confirmed Huon pine by the vendor?
